name: overalls
description: Status band above the prompt: context weather, usage limits, and the Ponytail and Caveman levels

weather.title: Weather detail
weather.description: How much of the context forecast to show: off, minimal, normal or full

ponytail.title: Ponytail level
ponytail.description: How to show whether Ponytail is installed and its current level: off, icon or text

caveman.title: Caveman mode
caveman.description: How to show the mode the Caveman plugin runs in, when it's installed: off, icon or text

megacave.title: Offer megacave
megacave.description: List Caveman's Classical Chinese mode (megacave) in its dropdown: on or off

limits.title: Usage limits
limits.description: Show how much of your 5-hour and weekly usage is spent: on or off

resets.title: Limit resets
resets.description: Show how long until each usage limit resets: on or off

cost.title: Session cost
cost.description: Show what this session has cost so far: on or off

mcp.title: MCP warnings
mcp.description: Warn in the band when an MCP server or connector fails or needs signing in again: on or off

agents.title: Running agents
agents.description: Show how many subagents are running, and list them on press: on or off

turns.title: Turns left
turns.description: Show about how many more turns fit in the context, at the pace of the last few: on or off

runout.title: Limit run-out
runout.description: Warn when a usage limit will run out before it resets, at your pace over the last hour: off, warn or always (always also marks a limit that lasts)

denials.title: Tool denials
denials.description: Show tool calls that were refused (by you, a hook or a permission rule) until dismissed: on or off
